shared_elements: raised/plastic relief combined with shallow incised outlines on the same surface
paired repeated motifs arranged in a row
justification: Both are weathered stone carvings that combine bolder raised relief with much shallower incised or lightly modelled motifs, and both set repeated curved forms in a rough row, which is the most concrete correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a horizontal block bearing recognisable animal bodies rendered in bold, rounded three-dimensional relief, whereas B is a vertical monumental figure whose surface carries flat, abstract rings, crescents and bands with no depicted creatures.
